relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: One represented billed-revenue invoice as recorded in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one invoices.json object by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per invoice_id; copy billed_name, amount, currency, period, and status verbatim from billing JSON.

relations.name: account_record
relations.meaning: One CRM account row as recorded in crm.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one crm.csv data row by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: C1: referent id crm:<crm_account_id>; copy account_name verbatim.

relations.name: entity_record
relations.meaning: One company-registry row as recorded in company_registry.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one registry row by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: C1: referent id registry:<company_number>; copy legal_name verbatim.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: One contract document header with source-native identifier and counterparty name as stated in the parties clause.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one contract markdown file; contract_id is filename without .md.
relations.construction_rule: C1: referent id contract:<filename_without_md>; parse Counterparty line verbatim into counterparty_text.

relations.name: contract_term
relations.meaning: Effective date, stated term mechanics, and explicit expiry date as recorded in a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the Effective, Term, and Expiry lines of the contract file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse Effective and Term lines; copy Expiry only when explicitly stated (e.g. expired SOW); leave expiry_date empty when not recorded.

relations.name: contract_section
relations.meaning: One numbered contract section heading and body text as extracted from the source document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one markdown section (number, heading, and following prose) in a contract file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: split contract markdown on ## headings; section_ref is the section number token; heading and body copied verbatim.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two cross-system record identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded evidence packet traceable to authoritative sources; SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not mere name compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: assert only grounded judgments on generated candidate pairs; mechanical acceptance permitted for exact legal-form variants of the same registered name.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit directed pairs required to connect each CRM account, its invoice billed-name identifier, governing contract identifier, and registry rows that are candidate legal entities for that commercial relationship; exclude global cross-product.

relations.name: contract_lifecycle_judgment
relations.meaning: Under an explicit lifecycle policy, whether a contract is in force or has lapsed based on recorded term and expiry facts.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in contract_term dates and document-type cues; expired statement-of-work inactive under diligence_active policy.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: evaluate contract_term for the named policy; treat explicit expiry as controlling; do not infer closed-world negatives.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract_record tuple for each policy referenced by purposes A and C (diligence_active).
relations.unresolved_judgment: active indeterminate when term mechanics or expiry cannot be read from sources

relations.name: clause_kind_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether a recorded contract section qualifies as a named analytical clause kind for acquisition exposure or commercial-dependency obligation analysis.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_section body text that supports or withholds the classification.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: classify only against contract_section tuples; acquisition kinds per purpose A policy; obligation kinds exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term per purpose C policy.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian filter: each contract_section crossed with clause_kind values allowed by the consuming purpose contract.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoices whose recorded billing status is open.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT invoice FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: reconciliation_link
relations.meaning: Directed identity-reconciliation pairs that purpose B must connect across CRM, billing, contract, and registry identifiers.
relations.grounding_contract: Completeness receipt over the generated reconciliation graph.
relations.construction_rule: C4: materialize required directed edges from account_record, invoice_record, contract_record, and entity_record without asserting disposition.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Same coverage rule as identity_judgment candidate_generation_rule; supplies left/right columns only.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_assessment
relations.meaning: Per-contract commercial-dependency disposition under purpose C current-relationship and obligation policies.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs include open_invoice, contract_lifecycle_judgment, clause_kind_judgment, and identity_judgment; unresolved joins force status unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: C4: dependent when active contract, qualifying obligation ACCEPT, and current-relationship evidence hold; unresolved when any required join or judgment is UNRESOLVED; never emit false negative from missing identity.

relations.name: contractual_exposure_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoice rows qualifying for purpose A with asserted or unresolved billed-name-to-contract association.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs include invoice_record, identity_judgment, contract_lifecycle_judgment, and clause_kind_judgment ACCEPT rows for acquisition kinds.
relations.construction_rule: C4: include invoice when active contract has acquisition-relevant clause ACCEPT; map identity SAME_ENTITY to disposition asserted and UNRESOLVED to unresolved; do not suppress on uncertain identity.
